rationale: Single static regulation PDF, but it is the reporting schema that defines which CBK payment-instrument series must exist — archive once as reference.
One-off SPN/KIPS interbank regulation PDF; vocabulary and participant definitions for reading CBK volume series, not a recurring feed.
Static e-payment-instruments regulation PDF; defines the issuer population behind card statistics, useful as reference only.
National Payments Council hub recurrently publishes minutes carrying headline terminal/instrument figures ahead of the statistical tables — a standalone signal producer.
NSSVP strategy hub with quantified non-cash targets and monitoring reports; URL check failed against the Cloudflare-defended host, so re-verify in the browser pass.
CBK Annual Report archive with a dedicated payment-systems chapter — a durable annual anchor for SPN/KIPS, account and e-banking figures.
Highest-frequency CBK release archive running since 2014; worth monitoring to catch any monthly-cadence payment or account indicators.
Serbian-language mirror of the bqk-kos.org payment-systems section; covered by monitoring the parent domain with the lang parameter, not a standalone source.
IMF FAS gives a standardised machine-readable annual ATM/POS series for Kosovo — the key independent cross-check on CBK; failed fetch is a soft signal on a live IMF portal.
FRED API mirror of the FAS Kosovo ATM series: lowest-friction continuously updated baseline that bypasses CBK bot defences.
Global Findex 2025 is the only demand-side card/digital-payment and cash-reliance evidence for Kosovo, but microdata download requires a registered account.
Bank report archives give per-institution ATM/POS/card and e-banking counts and market-share splits the CBK never publishes; recurring annual releases.
Kosovo Banking Association reached only via an unconfirmed bank-hosted path that failed verification; mine once for member leads if a real domain is confirmed.
ASK is the national statistical office and publishes ICT/e-banking usage surveys independent of the CBK chain — durable demand-side context and denominators.
Static KosGIRO scheme manual; supplies the instrument vocabulary needed to parse CBK breakdowns but produces no ongoing signal.
Possible less-defended second CBK host serving historical bulletins; value depends entirely on whether the browser pass finds it reachable.
Vendor with claimed Kosovo bank ATM work; solutions/country pages are a recurring surface for identifying which institutions run which self-service estate.
Recurring CEE ATM/EFT-POS landscape series with explicit Kosovo penetration figures — vendor-side estimates that predate official statistics; failed fetch is bot defence.
Vendor social channels carry Kosovo deployment announcements absent from the corporate site, but Facebook/LinkedIn collection is login-gated and needs human clearance.
Payten newsroom quantifies per-bank POS/ATM deliveries across the Western Balkans — the most likely first quantified disclosure of a Kosovo terminal win.
Group-structure page confirms the registered Prishtina entity; mine once to fix the actor identity, then track via Payten news and procurement instead.
WSE-listed issuer disclosures publish Payments-segment installed-base metrics and material contracts on a fixed quarterly calendar.
Single case study, but the richest quantified Kosovo card-infrastructure artefact found (Quipu TranzWare, dated contactless issuance volumes) — capture as evidence.
Quipu physically operates the Kosovo card processing and personalisation centre; its site is a standing window on issuance and acquiring capability.
Global ATM OEM newsroom; low Kosovo hit rate today but the place a fleet refresh or recycler rollout would appear with unit counts.
Alternate ATM OEM newsroom covering fleet wins and ATM-as-a-Service deals; low-cost tripwire for the competing installed-base hypothesis.
Static corporate-history page, but it carries a dated named Kosovo customer reference (Raiffeisen Kosovo mobile bank) identifying the digital-channel vendor.
